posts.content_md:
Hey guys,

my friend Guillermo and I opened a lab in Hamburg, Germany for making DCG holograms.

We want to offer DCG workshops to everyone, but especially to the holography community.

My path in DCG has been very long and tough.

Just search my posting history and you'll see. 

Finally I reached a point where the results I am getting are good and consistent.

I have received so much help from this forum and now I want to give it back.

I want to show others how DCG can be done.

So if you are in the area, just contact us via our website or drop me a line on the forum and we'll make it happen.

Kind Regards

Swann Rack

[www.holocreators.com](http://www.holocreators.com)
